basis: Pinned active PS01 remains unchanged. TG01 allows an explicit nominal 640px preview request, separate metadata/partial names per size; source and stop/decode safeguards unchanged. chunks uses 640 for new previews. prepare verifies these local hashes in addition to all pinned source blobs. receipt distinguishes decode-stop events from HTTP attempts and records preview size evidence. receipt also distinguishes a completed under-floor review with no source acquisition from transport incompleteness. Explicit 480px preview requests are also supported for portrait bucket overshoot at 640; never automatically substituted.
